# Social preview source

The repository preview is rendered at 1280×640 from three lossless sources:

- `background.png`: original 1774×887 quota-observatory artwork.
- the canonical white ChatGPT panel glyph under `icons/`.
- deterministic SVG typography and layout generated by `render.py`.
- output copy and repository-relative paths from `variants.json`.

The committed output is `.github/social-preview.png`. Render every configured
variant with:

```console
make social-preview
```

Verify that the committed PNGs still match their sources with:

```console
make check-social-preview
```

Both commands process every profile in `variants.json`. A future Cinnamon
Spices, distribution or campaign profile can define its copy and output path
there while keeping the artwork, icon, typography and layout shared.

The background was generated specifically for ChatGPT Usage with the built-in
ImageGen tool and this prompt:

> Use case: stylized-concept
>
> Asset type: GitHub repository social-preview background, final canvas
> intended for 1280×640 (2:1 landscape)
>
> Primary request: Create a premium abstract technology observatory for a
> Cinnamon desktop applet that keeps ChatGPT Work and Codex usage limits
> beautifully in view.
>
> Scene/backdrop: deep near-black graphite and midnight blue desktop-like
> atmosphere, with the entire left 55 percent calm, dark, and low-detail for
> later branding; the right 45 percent contains a luminous abstract quota
> telemetry system.
>
> Subject: on the right, three elegant concentric or offset orbital progress
> arcs and tiny traveling data pulses, connected to a subtle 24-hour rhythm of
> small vertical light bars near the lower right; suggest live limits, reset
> countdowns, history, and calm awareness without showing an actual app
> screenshot.
>
> Style/medium: refined cinematic 3D abstract artwork with crisp glassy light,
> sophisticated open-source product branding, restrained rather than flashy;
> original composition.
>
> Composition/framing: exact wide 2:1 composition; generous safe margins; no
> important details on the far edges; left side reserved for deterministic
> icon, headline, copy, and badges; right-side focal point around x=78%, y=43%.
>
> Lighting/mood: calm, intelligent, reassuring, quietly magical; subtle
> volumetric glow and depth, excellent thumbnail readability.
>
> Color palette: near-black #090b10, graphite #202126, cool gray, OpenAI-like
> emerald green, Cinnamon mint green, electric cyan, a very restrained violet
> accent.
>
> Materials/textures: smooth dark glass, fine luminous particles, delicate
> orbital trails, subtle grain, no noisy nebula.
>
> Constraints: background art only; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos,
> no icons, no screenshots, no UI panels, no people, no watermark; preserve a
> clean dark left field; do not imitate the Proton Drive event-horizon image.
>
> Avoid: generic AI brain imagery, robots, chat bubbles, circuit-board clichés,
> floating laptops, excessive neon, rainbow colors, clutter, symmetrical
> bullseye centered on canvas.
